# Source: Panel Entitled "Femme à marguerite" (Woman with Daisy)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Panel Entitled "Femme à marguerite" (Woman with Daisy)
- **Artist / culture:** Designed by Alphonse Marie Mucha Czech, 1860–1939 Produced by Scheurer Lauth & Cie, founded 1813 France, Mulhouse
- **Date:** c. 1898/1900
- **Style:** Art Nouveau
- **Classification:** weaving - printed
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 182672
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/182672
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/25f1f8c4-5ebf-3aa7-3854-4c092d620656/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Art Nouveau

## Extracted source palette

`#F8F8F8, #D8D8A8, #280818, #E8E8C8, #B8B888, #480828, #989878, #B8C8A8`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#15040C`
- `surface`: `#302128`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B8B888`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#480828`
- `surface_variant`: `#302128`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#55484E`
- `error`: `#B8B888`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `rounded` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `16dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.73:1`, surface `14.37:1`
- Variant contrast: `14.37:1`
- Control contrast: `9.54:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
